ep0.title: Status da semana: atrasado ou no prazo?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Welcome to Ouvir com o Erick. Today: the weekly status meeting. My guest is Ana, a project manager.

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: Hi Erick! Status meetings are my life.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: So, Ana, what do people say when a project is late?

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: The easy one is: we're running behind.

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: For example: we're running behind on the data migration.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: And when everything is fine?

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: Then you say: we're on track. We're on track for Friday.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: What if you're blocked?

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: Say why. We're still waiting for access to the test system.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Nice. And how do you ask for help?

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: Could you talk to the Basis team? Could you send me the logs?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Could you sounds like cúdja, right?

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: Exactly. Nobody says could, you, slowly.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Last question: how do you end the update?

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: Keep it short: I'll keep you posted.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Thanks, Ana! Now it's your turn. Sophia is waiting for your update.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Hey, welcome to Ouvir com o Erick. I'm Erick, and today my friend Kate is here.

lines.speaker: kate
lines.text: Hi Erick! Happy Monday.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Happy Monday! So, how was your weekend?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Did you do anything fun?

lines.speaker: kate
lines.text: Not much, to be honest. I stayed home and watched a couple of movies.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: That sounds nice. I went to the beach with my sister.

lines.speaker: kate
lines.text: Lucky you! Was it crowded?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Super crowded. But the water was great.

lines.speaker: kate
lines.text: What are you gonna do this week?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: I'm gonna work a lot.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: We've got a big presentation on Thursday.

lines.speaker: kate
lines.text: Oh, are you nervous?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: A little. I'm gonna practice tonight.

lines.speaker: kate
lines.text: You'll be fine. Hey, do you wanna grab a coffee before the meeting?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Sure! Let me finish this email first.

lines.speaker: kate
lines.text: No rush. See you in ten minutes.

ep2.title: Está me ouvindo? A reunião online

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Welcome back! Today, the classic online meeting. My guest is Priya, a project manager.

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: Hi everyone. Erick, can you hear me okay?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Yeah, I can hear you. But your video is frozen.

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: Oh no. Let me turn my camera off and on again.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Okay, you're back!

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: Great. So, could you share your screen for a sec?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Sure. Can you see the dashboard now?

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: Yes. Sorry, you're breaking up a little.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Is it better now?

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: Much better. What do you think about the new numbers?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: They look good, but sales went down in March.

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: I didn't get that. Can you say that again?

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Sales went down in March. I'll send you the report after the call.

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: Perfect. Let's wrap this up, we're out of time.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Hey, it's Erick. Today we're talking SAP with Marcus, who works in IT.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Hey Erick. Thanks for having me.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: So, you're in the middle of a big rollout, right?

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Yeah, we're going live with the new finance module on Friday.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Friday? Are you ready?

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Honestly, we're running a bit late.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: We found some bugs in testing.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: What kind of bugs?

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: The payment run didn't work for two suppliers.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Ouch. Did you fix it?

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: We fixed one. We're still working on the other.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Are you gonna move the go-live?

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: I don't know yet.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: We're supposed to get approval from the director first.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: What would you do differently?

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: We should've tested it with real data before.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Good lesson. Good luck on Friday!

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Welcome to another episode. Laura works in finance, and it's the end of the month.

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Yes, the busiest week of my life. Every month!

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: What do you need to do this week?

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: We need to close the books by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: And we need to check every invoice.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: There's a problem with three invoices.

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: The numbers don't match.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: What are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: I'm gonna call the supplier this afternoon.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: And the budget? I heard you need to cut costs.

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Yeah, we need to cut costs by about ten percent.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: That's a lot. Where are you gonna cut?

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Travel, mostly. And fewer external consultants.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Well, let me know if you need help.

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Thanks, Erick. I'll get back to you.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Today my guest is Tom. He just came back from a business trip to Chicago.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Hi Erick. Yeah, I'm still a little tired.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: How was the trip?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Good, but the flight was delayed for three hours.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Oh no. Did you miss your meeting?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Almost! I went straight from the airport to the client's office.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Did you have time to eat?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Not really. I grabbed a sandwich in the taxi.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: And how did the meeting go?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Really well. They wanna start the project next month.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: That's great news! Did you get to see the city?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: A little. I walked by the river on the last night. It was beautiful.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Are you gonna go back?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: I hope so. Probably in December.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: This is Erick, and today it's just me. Let's talk about giving bad news at work.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Last month, I had to tell my manager that a project was gonna be late.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: I was gonna send an email, but I decided to call her instead.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: First, I didn't wait. I told her as soon as I knew.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: I said: I've gotta be honest with you, we're about two weeks behind.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Then I explained why, in one or two sentences, no drama.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: And I brought a plan: here's what we can do, and here's what I need from you.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: She wasn't happy, but she said: thanks for telling me early.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: The lesson? Bad news doesn't get better with time.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: If you're gonna be late, say it early, and come with options.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: Next time you have a tough conversation in English, try these phrases.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: I've gotta be honest. We're running behind. Here's what I suggest.

lines.speaker: erick
lines.text: See you in the next episode!

lines.speaker: sophia
lines.text: Oh no! Sorry, they give you… or they ___ you? It happened this afternoon, right?

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Oh, they gave me a room with one bed!

lines.speaker: sophia
lines.text: Got it, thank you! I can move you to a double room on the fifth floor. Would that work for you?
